column1: # status: AI-drafted spellings, not yet reviewed by a native speaker
# To add a spelling you actually type, append it to the right row. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# Rules that stop a word being read as a number.
# not_number_if_prev: the word is not a number when the word before it is in the list (de do = 'give')
# not_number_if_next: ... when the word after it is in the list (ek baar = 'once')
# verb_if_clause_final: the word is a verb when it ends a clause after an ordinary word (ticket do); 'connectors' are excepted (ek ya do)
# needs_numeric_neighbour: only a number next to another number, scale or currency word (saath = 60, but usually 'with')
# no_fuzzy: real words that must never be spelling-corrected into a number word
